user_story:
As a user, I want to add and remove elements on the page so that I can dynamically control the number of elements displayed to me.  Acceptance Criteria: 
- I should be able to click the 'Add Element' button to add a new element to the list. 
- Upon adding an element, the element should be present in the DOM under the <div id='elements'>. 
- I should be able to click on the added element to remove it. 
- If I remove the element, it should no longer be visible in the <div id='elements'>.
